fixer.reason: No P0-P2 findings and no production bugs; the 4 P3 review findings are accepted as non-blocking (see notes)

findings.note: Retry after a partial send (guests invited, cancellation to removed guests failed) re-sends the invitation to guests; rare double mail of an idempotent iTIP REQUEST, not worth another fix/review round
No client-side stop at the server's 20-reminder limit; the server rejects and the editor shows the generic save error, nothing is lost
'Save your changes first' hint and guest input linger after undo/failed save/reload; cosmetic, cleared when the editor closes
Date in 'Create task/note from event' title uses the event's time zone instead of the user's; differs only for timed events near midnight in another zone, title is editable
